==Hello Anon==
<span style="font-size:13px;"> You have been busy haven't you? We the members of this wiki would really like it if you made a username so we could get to know you. I'm not sure how the others feel, but I don't think you're really in the spirit of what we are trying to do here. We, or I, at least, want to see this wiki become the most complete and concise Wheel of Time database out there. I understand how you feel about spoilers, but this is a site where some spoilers are to be expected and anticipated. The members of this site try to help where they can, including puting a spoiler warning on the main page. Your efforts to hide these spoilers is damaging to the previously stated purpose, and I regard them as nothing but vandalisim. Also your comments while trying to "correct" these spoilers are inapropriate for a public site, and not apreciated. I would like it very much if you would create a username and joined us in good faith to become an editor of the site. You could also leave us to it. Your choice.</span>
